title: Start an AI Side Hustle This Week (3 Steps)
description: A simple 3-step plan to start a freelance side hustle using free AI tools: pick a skill, make samples, find clients. Follow for more ways to earn with AI. #shorts #ai #sidehustle #freelancing #makemoneyonline

scenes.narration: You can start a side hustle with free AI tools this week. Here is exactly how.
Step one: pick one skill people already pay for, like writing product descriptions, editing short videos, or making social media posts.
Let AI speed it up. Claude or ChatGPT can draft the writing, and Canva can design the graphics in minutes.
scenes.on_screen_text: Let AI do the heavy lifting

scenes.narration: Step two: make three free samples, and put them in a simple portfolio or a shared Google Drive folder.
Step three: offer your service on Fiverr or Upwork, or message small local businesses directly.
Always check and fix the AI's work yourself. Clients pay for quality, not for AI.
Follow for more ways to earn with AI.
